exposure: Children with ALL but not cALL
Type of leukemia (acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL), acute myelogenous leukemia (AML), common ALL (cALL))
cohort: Children from the California Childhood Leukemia Study (CCLS)
finding: Cesarean section delivery was significantly associated with cALL, particularly in Hispanic children.
